terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.section1Content: These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your use of the Deveng Discord bot, optional custom bot offerings where available, and the web management panel at deveng.app (together, the "Services") provided by Deveng Bot ("we", "us"). By inviting the bot, signing in to the panel, or otherwise using the Services, you agree to these Terms and to Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.
terms.section2Content: We provide hosted tools to configure automation, moderation, engagement, and related features on Discord servers you control or are authorized to manage. Features, limits, and availability may change. The Services are provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.
terms.section3Content: You must not use the Services to break the law, harass others, distribute malware, send spam, or evade Discord safety systems. You must not use the Services to collect or process illegal content. You are responsible for your server rules, staff actions, and compliance with applicable laws. We may suspend or terminate access if we reasonably believe you violated these Terms, Discord policy, or law.
terms.section4Content: Panel access may use Discord OAuth. You must only configure servers where you have authority to do so. You are responsible for safeguarding your Discord account and for bot permissions you approve. If you use a custom bot product, you are responsible for your Discord application credentials and token security.
terms.section5Content: Deveng may change feature availability and reasonable per-server quotas to keep the Service reliable. Core tools are available without fees from this dashboard; limits exist to keep the service reliable.
terms.section6Content: Deveng Bot owns the Services, branding, and documentation, subject to third-party and open-source licenses where stated. We grant you a limited, revocable license to use the Services as intended. You may not copy our panel UI, scrape our infrastructure at scale, or misrepresent affiliation with Deveng Bot.
terms.section7Content: TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, THE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND. DEVENG GROUP WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES, OR ANY LOSS OF PROFITS, DATA, OR GOODWILL, ARISING FROM YOUR USE OF THE SERVICES.
terms.section8Content: We may update these Terms. If changes are material, we will provide notice when reasonable (for example, by posting an updated date or notice in the panel or on our site). Continued use after updates constitutes acceptance. Contact: support@deveng.global. Community support: https://discord.gg/deveng-bot

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Content: This Privacy Policy describes how Deveng Bot ("we") processes personal data when you use our Discord bot and management panel at deveng.app (the "Services"). Privacy enquiries: privacy@deveng.global. General support: support@deveng.global.
privacy.section2Content: When you sign in with Discord OAuth, we receive identifiers and profile information Discord shares with us (such as user ID, username, avatar, email when provided by Discord, and the list of guilds you share for authorization). We also process technical data (IP address, user agent, timestamps) for security and service reliability, and configuration data you save in the panel. Bank credential handling is outside the scope of this dashboard.
privacy.section3Content: We use data to authenticate you, authorize dashboard access, operate bot features you enable, store your settings, provide support, improve the Services, detect abuse, and comply with law. We do not sell your personal data. See our Cookie Policy and GDPR Notice for additional detail where applicable.
privacy.section4Content: We use service providers for hosting, databases, logging, and analytics. Subprocessors process data on our instructions under appropriate agreements. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect rights, safety, and the integrity of the Services.
privacy.section5Content: The panel uses cookies and similar technologies for authentication, security, and preferences (such as theme and language). You can control cookies through your browser; blocking strictly necessary cookies may break sign-in.
privacy.section6Content: If data is processed in countries other than yours, we use appropriate safeguards where required (such as standard contractual clauses) or rely on adequacy decisions.
privacy.section7Content: We retain data only as long as needed to provide the Services, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and meet legal obligations. You may request deletion subject to verification and legal exceptions.
privacy.section8Content: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, or object to certain processing, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. To exercise privacy rights: privacy@deveng.global. General support: support@deveng.global. Help server: https://discord.gg/deveng-bot
privacy.section9Content: The dashboard is offered without charge, with fair operational limits; contact support@deveng.global for account matters.

aiModeration.thresholdOrderInvalid: Thresholds must follow the order log ≤ delete ≤ timeout

aiModeration.generalSettingsSavedDesc: The changes were written to the server.

aiModeration.disableConfirmDescription: The queue integration stops; your settings are kept.
aiModeration.generalSettingsDescription: First observe with review only (log); then switch to automatic deletion or timeout modes. The thresholds below are the default AI sensitivity for all categories; each category can be fine-tuned separately on the Rules tab.
aiModeration.modeDeleteAndTimeout: Delete + timeout on very high confidence
aiModeration.saveSettingsHint: After making changes, press Save general settings. A notification appears on a successful save; if none appears, the settings were not written to the server.

moderator.ruleServerInvitesDescription: Detects Discord server invite links (discord.gg/xxx or discord.com/invite/xxx).
moderator.ruleExternalLinksDescription: Detects links to external websites outside of Discord.
moderator.ruleExcessiveCapsDescription: Detects when more than 70% of a message is uppercase. (Messages shorter than 10 characters are not checked)

moderator.ruleExcessiveSpoilerDescription: Detects the use of more than 5 spoilers (||text||) in a message.
moderator.ruleExcessiveMentionDescription: Detects more than 5 user or role mentions in a message.
moderator.ruleZalgoDescription: Detects the use of Zalgo text (text containing combined diacritical marks).
moderator.ruleSpamProtectionDescription: Detects when the same user sends the same message 3+ times within 5 seconds.
